Curren Bouquetd'or (Tracksuit Winter) walks in
*Assuming she changed into winter tracksuit from here

Seeing her summon every ounce of courage to make her plea, I could feel her sincerity.
—There was no doubt a change was taking place in her heart.

Eye-chaaan!
We're countin' on that eye-opening late kick!

It's all thanks to you, Trainer. ...While I was agonizing over whether to keep racing,
you stayed right beside my heart time and time again.

—There is something I want to achieve.
And to do that, I have to win... So, I will run—!
Here I go! Haaaaaaaaah!!

...Bouquet-chan.
Your running today was completely different from before.

You've changed this much. You can become even stronger!
So let's race again. In the Twinkle Series!

(...What fierce spirit—Eye-san's overwhelming aura threatens to push me back.
Even so—)

If she missed this chance, her talent would likely fade away unfulfilled.
And above all else—
(If I want to take that person's hand—I have to show my resolve!)

...Would you come watch the event trials?
To see whether or not I have the resolve to fight for victory—

There is no Trainer as wonderful as you.
I want to show that brilliance to everyone. —With my running.

Kuh—! But I can still turn this around!
The real battle begins in the home stretch!

She resolved to change herself just to challenge the world alongside me—
I want to answer that call.
—! ...Trainer...!
—A sharp light flashed within her eyes.

Yet trainers often considered that gentle nature ill-suited for fierce competition—
a reputation that had caused me worry.
Excuse me—!
Would you please... become my Trainer...?!
Yaaaaaaaaaaaah!

...Her tear-filled eyes wavered. Yet,
even while wracked with anxiety, her gaze remained fixed directly on me.

—It came completely out of the blue.
I never could have dreamed she would ask for an exclusive contract.

Um... Eye-san!
Let's have a great race today...!

She offers a gentle smile. Softly, like a blossoming flower.
—I vowed in my heart to help this sparkling smile bloom in all its beauty.

Yes...! I will debut.
I will run—aiming for victory...!

...Right now, I can't even offer you a single flower of victory.
But with you—I know I can do my best.

—I wanted to win and show you my resolve.
It hurts so much...
—I want to deliver a golden, radiant bouquet to you.

...She's a similar type. The thought that I might not
be able to provide what she's lacking makes me hesitate.

If she can keep this up, Curren Bouquetd'or has a shot at winning.
However, entering the final straight—

(—What an incredible cheer... Everyone came to see Eye-san.
Going up against someone with so much spotlight on her... But still—!)

Yes, nice to meet you. I won't lose to anyone!
Not even to you, Bouquet-chan!
Ngh...!

I... I-I can't say I'm full of confidence.
But...—I don't have any hesitation.

Curren Bouquetd'or flinches, overwhelmed by the momentum.
Her face contorts in pain, just as it usually does.
Leading up to the glorious bouquet—our very first victory!
I want you to be there to witness it...!
Yes—! I'll do my very best...!

Not just for me, but for every Umamusume—Trainers pour
everything they have into us, sparing no time nor effort.

She holds on tight. Chasing after Almond Eye,
who craves victory more fiercely than anyone!
And then, gathering enough victories to overflow from both hands.

She, Curren Bouquetd'or, is a girl who always decorates
the Trainers' lounge with flowers. A gentle, soft-spoken Umamusume.

So please—
Will you become my Trainer...!

*pant*, *pant*...—I couldn't... win...—This race was the one.
I wanted to win it so badly...—*sob*, *sniffle*...

However—her soft brown eyes are wavering.
Her clenched fists are trembling faintly as well.

Since she seemed to be hesitating about quitting racing altogether at one point,
I had assumed she wouldn't be debuting anytime soon.

Here she comes, Almond Eye!
Among all the Umamusume debuting this year, she's completely cut above the rest!

...Yes.
I look forward to working with you—!

—In the race, Almond Eye got off to a slow start,
while Curren Bouquetd'or secured a favorable position in the leading pack.

—The Divisional Athletic Meet.
The race Curren Bouquetd'or is running is the Turf 1600m. And there—

—Trainer-san.
I'm so sorry... You came all this way to watch me, and yet I lost.
